relationship_to_original_57: Original requirements remain authoritative for overwrite mode. This explicit new mode adds namespace deletion semantics and simplified presentation; it does not weaken system protection or authorize arbitrary process termination. R44 identity deduplication remains for overwrite; quick mode deduplicates namespace selections, preserving selected hardlink names. Quick pause/retry is in-session only, without persistent erase checkpoints.

requirements.text: Replace the four-tab workflow with one primary list, explicit mode selection, essential actions and compact progress. Move diagnostics/recovery/resource tuning behind collapsed details.
Add a distinct quick permanent-delete mode that bypasses the recycle bin and does not overwrite, read back, issue file TRIM or perform VSS/ADS sanitization analysis.
Freeze selected namespaces before confirmation; revalidate original identity, creation time, type, protected status and nofollow ancestors before mutation. New or replaced objects are excluded.

Complete the fast pass before attempting failure recovery. Do not query locks, close programs or recover access for targets that have not failed. Retain per-path preparation failures and continue accessible siblings.
Attempt normal closing of eligible lock owners in the final phase, deduplicate equivalent process actions, and require fresh individual process confirmation for any forced termination.
Allow targeted access recovery only for failed, frozen, non-system targets. Prefer scoped thread privileges with unchanged persistent owner/DACL; fail explicitly if safe recovery is unavailable.
Delete all explicitly selected hardlink namespaces independently; preserve unselected aliases and never overwrite shared contents. Keep existing reparse rejection/no-follow and system protection.
Use bounded parallel work and bounded retry counts. Process directory removal after children. Pause/cancel stop remaining work; quick retry uses only the in-session frozen plan and its bound report.
Quick outcomes report namespace removal only; no recoverability, reclaimed-space, physical-erasure or platform-maximum-throughput claim. Keep errors and finalization failures visible.
Keep diagnostics without per-file durable logging in the fast pass: durable job boundaries, final failed-target details in validated bounded batches, existing private logs/rotation.
Preserve overwrite-mode guarantees, module-first architecture, original toolchain/encoding constraints and source RC/native test responsibility gates.
Successfully completed entries leave the input list; failures and ambiguous aliases remain. Confirmation cannot authorize a different mode, queue generation or fingerprint.
